description: Debug a Node 20 job worker that dies every few minutes with an unhandled rejection after a deploy: a fire-and-forget refresh round nobody catches, a Promise.all that hides which job failed, a retry helper that never gives up, and a log line that claims success. Fix the root causes in src/ and prove it with node check.js.

criteria: The defect chain in src/ is fixed at the root cause - refreshAll reports each failing item with its id and the original error message instead of letting a rejection escape through the fire-and-forget round, the retry helper gives up after the configured attempts and rethrows, and the success log only appears when the round really succeeded - with the gate, the incident doc, the log and the README untouched and node check.js fully green.
